title: Claude-real-video － any LLM can watch a video
summary: Claude-real-video is an open-source project that enables Large Language Models like Claude to analyze and understand video content, effectively allowing any LLM to 'watch' videos and provide contextual insights or descriptions.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between visual/video content and text-based AI models, enabling LLMs to process and understand video information that traditionally required specialized computer vision systems.
why_valuable: democratizes video understanding for AI applications, making it accessible to any LLM without requiring custom computer vision models or complex integration pipelines.
